chunks: Then they reflected upon themselves and said: 'Surely you are yourselves the unjust.'
ai.seo_question: Who realized they were unjust in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological shift from external blame to internal accountability, illustrating how the disbelievers of Hud (AS) recognized that their ruin was self-inflicted through their own arrogance. This moment of 'returning to themselves' signifies a critical juncture where truth becomes undeniable, yet often comes too late for redemption. It serves as a practical lesson for believers to cultivate self-awareness before divine punishment becomes inevitable.
